notes.title: New Baby Duka Game About To Launch On Steam! (trailer)
notes.content:
Hi all followers and Baby Duka fans :urbansocial: Today I'm proud to announce the launch of a new teaser for my current production: DASH - a 2D platformer creation tool for creative and competitive players. In the colorful and sometimes far our style of Baby Duka. Custom physics built for solid control (speedruns), and an atmospheric editor which will feel like your second home after a while. I'm very excited to share more content and news with you once the game's store page is ready. I'm aiming to reveal the Steam presence of DASH late July/August 2018! It's going to be a 100% community-driven experience with a program designed for UGC, the Workshop and free monthly updates with new heroes, blocksets, game modes and much much more.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/1aab09d51d92109d39b3cef034f81d42043c6583.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/dfa482c4e5b164ac0d04686bdcdf11feeecee9d8.gif

Check out the trailer  right here ►  

- BD

notes.title: New Baby Duka Game & Urban Pirate's 2 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
2 YEARS SINCE THE RELEASE OF URBAN PIRATE

Mid June 2016 the crime simulator 'Urban Pirate' was launched on Steam and around 500 pirates had themselves an urban adventure. That's about two years ago and for that reason we're practically giving the grimy game away - it's 75% off (1,50€) in the store until 5th of July.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/57be5ca3f26e1885685bf2af4bb504c5dc653ffe.png

The game was the first to be produced entirely by Baby Duka and was self-funded. The Copenhagen-based audio producer B Magic Samples delivered an original and fresh pack of sounds and songs.

The game was later ported to Linux.

October 2016 Urban Pirate was nominated Best Idea at the VII Annual Independent Games Festival in Bilbao.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/bdea876d41c6fcd599fac869443ab970802d3f03.gif

Two years after the release over 6000 units have been activated on Steam (though only 17 reviews...), at least 60 people have completed the merciless and almost impossible 90s VGA-like game, 1 person made a guide, and over 100 gameplay vids are uploaded.

Here's the ultimate playlist if you want to hang out and watch some urban crime. :urbanhappy::urbanspraycan:

DASH - Danger Action Speed Heroes NEW Game By Baby Duka

Since December 2017 Baby Duka has been busy working on a prototype of a new game. And not just any game. I won't say more here, but I advice you check out the DASHlog. Here all the development is documented and shared. This is especially for you who find the development exciting.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/9ac425fb1fe60928754cfe9925e567501690e30a.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/dfa482c4e5b164ac0d04686bdcdf11feeecee9d8.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/62946a05f5310d36e32a776a0edd95a429e6082d.gif

And I can say as much as it's another colorful and edgy world we're about to witness.

Baby Duka is streaming the content from the latest build every Saturday on Twitch.

notes.title: *Bleep*, *bleep*, *bleep* (looping forever...)
notes.content:
To those of you who have experienced an annoying loop of *bleep* when pressing NEW GAME in the intro menu in Update 3.0.0.1, we have good news for you. An update is being uploaded [strike]within the next 24 hours[/strike]*, so you can play and enjoy the game without the bug. The update will still be called 3.0.0.1.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/ae9b3e2b7f6dfe24df27d1c6a69ba5014230b20e.jpg

The audio file was set to loop forever (true instead of false)...

Here's a way to go about the bug temporarily:

- Press NEW GAME
- In the Level Menu press MAIN MENU
- Press CONTINUE
- The never-ending *bleep* should be gone ːurbanhappyː

Thanks for your patience yall

* Unfortunately my laptop keyboard is broken (keys d and c don't work) so I have to copy/paste the letters because I didn't bring my extra keyboard to where I am now (far away from my workspace... from anything...) BUT the steam command prompt (where I am uploading the patch) won't allow me to copy/paste any letters into it, so it won't be fixed/uploaded until July 16th where I have my extra keyboard and back at the workspace. Sorry about that ːurbaninsaneː

notes.title: Update 3.0.0.1 Born For Shoplifting
notes.content:
Fellow pirates!!

We fixed the upgrade 'Born For Shoplifting' so that you actually get the upgrade, and a few other things that was bugging.

Some of you might receive an ERROR message when launching your awesome and unique save-game... This is, of course, something that could cause mutiny and pissed off pirates, we know that... But we figured you would rather want a full game with the upgrades right rather than the previous version where 'Born For Shoplifting' didn't get activated?

If you're working on a Let's Play and find it unreasonable to continue (in case you get the ERROR message and have to start over) we suggest you think twice. Remember that Urban Pirate is non-linear and you might just benefit from giving the first levels another go. If you're busy documenting the very last levels and your score is insane, all we can say is... arrrghhh!!!!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/741dafd233554ba4ebe29a55fb92aff80b505d5f.png

We're sorry bout that...

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/bad4152ec9c5b7a339f0b1b055fc14452bbde655.jpg

notes.title: NEW! Update 2.0.0.2: Let The Music Play!
notes.content:
EDIT: We are still experiencing playback issues with the soundtrack. We're working as fast as we can to fix this!

Please take 3 minutes and let Steam update the game on your system. Then the following fixes will be installed:

Bug fixes:

Changed the audio format of the soundtrack to be .wav instead of .mp3 to stabilize (not working still, still unstable)
Fixed bug: "Pusher Mission" displays local Achievement in Upgrade Menu when you have completed the checklist and level 3 (bonus mission not obligatory) and you will gain a bonus paid in Street Credit
Fixed bug: Sanity Level did not increase if Bad Sleep was prompted simultaniously in level >= 8
Fixed bug: Tank did not disappear when fight level was over

Enjoy and stay sane!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/f4fde118f3c8ddf73d1be559af63f14075094605.gif
